name: Fierce Shockwave
description: Settle a thread of qi in the grip so the shell stays fixed through a hard twist of the body.

name: Fusescorer
description: Pivot on the lead heel and fling the shell sideways from the hip to cross an enemy flank.

name: Spoon Linen
description: Keep the fuse count running in the ear while the eyes follow the foe over the shoulder.

name: Spoonzip
description: Dash three quick strides from the throwing spot to the nearest hard cover.

name: Rallying Fragment
description: Judge the pitch of the fuse hiss to tell a true shell from one that burns too fast.

name: Hungry Sizzle
description: Throw two shells in quick order a short space apart so their bursts cover a wider patch of ground.

name: Ducking Detonate
description: Rush forward on the heels of a burst while smoke and ringing ears still hold the defenders.

name: Sound Firecap
description: Trim a fuse to the measure of the distance by laying it along the thrower's forearm.

name: Doughty Fuse
description: Move arm and count together in one rhythm so release always falls on the same beat.

name: Swift Lever
description: Loft the shell on a high arc timed to burst low above men crowded behind a barrier.

name: Fierce Cap
description: Light a short fuse and throw in one snapping motion when the foe is close and time is gone.

name: Caphasp
description: Wait behind cover while a long fuse burns and keep the hand steady on the next shell.

name: Sure Casing
description: Mark the instant of the blast by sound and start the next count from it.

name: Rushing Shrapnel
description: Throw three shells with fuses cut to different lengths so the bursts fall one after another.

name: Levering Pinring
description: Toss a long-fuse shell short of the line to draw foes forward and hold them near the late blast.

name: Lithe Fragmentation
description: Run bent double along a trench floor with one hand trailing the side and the other holding a shell.

name: Kaboomthwack
description: Rise to the lip of the trench for one breath and toss the shell before dropping back.

name: Lever Screen
description: Wedge the shoulders into a dugout corner so a near blast cannot throw the body about.

name: Casingcordial
description: Wrap the fuses in oilcloth and test each for dampness before the line goes forward.

name: Ruthless Concussion
description: Throw the shell round a bend in the trench so it bursts among foes who cannot see the thrower.

name: Bold Powderchamber
description: Bank the shell off a timber face so it drops behind a traverse and bursts among the men beyond.

name: Bold Fuse
description: Release the shell at the top of a steep arm path so it rises high before it falls.

name: Hum Shrapnel
description: Aim for the point where the falling shell will land and not for the foe himself.

name: Ruthless Detonate
description: Lean back from the waist at release to add height when the target sits behind a high bank.

name: Rilllever
description: Cross the forearms before the face to turn aside a splinter or a shell lobbed at the head.

name: Casingzip
description: Shuffle sideways beneath the arc of an incoming shell to leave its landing place.

name: Humlever
description: Drop the shell just past a parapet so it falls into the angle between wall and floor.

name: Dawncap
description: Loft a shell and a second one after it so both fall together on a sheltered firing position.

name: Swift Concussion
description: Drop a shell onto a tiled roof so splinters and shattered tile fall on those sheltering beneath.

name: Rill Firecap
description: Swat a falling enemy shell aside with a qi-laced arm before it lands at the feet.

name: Ember Kaboom
description: Draw qi into the palm so the cold iron feels light and answers every small twist of the hand.

name: Sleet Powderchamber
description: Twist the wrist at release so the shell turns on its long axis and holds a straighter flight.

name: Shard Kaboom
description: Throw with the arm fully extended and qi flowing to the fingers to send the shell beyond its usual carry.

name: Clay Fragment
description: Turn the chest from a burst and let the back take the splinters with qi spread over the shoulder blades.

name: Gleam Pinring
description: Hold the breath and freeze the body for one instant before release to remove all sway from the aim.

name: Clay Cap
description: Lift the lead foot to the throwing mark and plant it so the stride ends exactly at the line.

name: Quickening Fuse
description: Study the colour of the spark at the fuse mouth to guess how fast the powder inside will burn.

name: Showercap
description: Whirl the arm and throw shells in quick order so bursts fall in a line across the ground.

name: Poise Casing
description: Lean into the push of a near blast and let qi at the chest turn its force aside.

name: Fragment Barrier
description: Snuff the fuse of a shell landing at the feet with qi-hardened fingers before the powder catches.

name: Gleam Fragmentation
description: Skim the shell low off a hard floor so it rises again beside the foe.

name: Shardspoon
description: Set the shell rolling down a slope so its own weight carries it to the foot of the enemy line.

name: Casing Bandage
description: Read the angle of a masonry face to guess where a rebounding shell will leave it.

name: Poise Pinring
description: Stop a rolling enemy shell with the sole of the boot and kick it back along its path.

name: Brawnspoon
description: Dive off the lip of a shelf as the shell comes down to land clear of its reach.

name: Casingthwack
description: Throw so the shell strikes two surfaces in turn and bursts in a corner the foe thought safe.

name: Shockwave Thwack
description: Send a shell rolling down a street gutter so it bursts under a line of men pressed to the housefront.

name: Candor Spoon
description: Splice two lengths of fuse with qi-steadied fingers and test the join with a short trial burn.

name: Brisk Sizzle
description: Seat the fuse deep in the shell mouth and press it home so no gap lets the spark die.

name: Candor Powderchamber
description: Pick a slow fuse for a long throw and a fast one for a short throw by the feel of its weave.

name: Sleetcap
description: Shelter the lit fuse under a cupped hand and a fold of cloak against rain and wind.

name: Capswat
description: Light and throw in a single rush when the enemy is nearly on the line and nothing else is possible.

name: Claykaboom
description: Fling the shell while stepping backward so the foe's rush meets the burst and not the thrower.

name: Gritkaboom
description: Heave a corded bundle of shells so their fuses catch together and they burst in one place.

name: Static Sizzle
description: Throw a fast shell and a slow shell together so the first drives foes down and the second bursts among them.

name: Staticlever
description: Throw through a narrow gap in a broken barrier so the shell lands in the room behind.

name: Stout Spoon
description: Crouch behind rubble heaped by the last burst and let its mass catch the iron splinters.

name: Casingflog
description: Stand to one side of a doorframe and swing only the arm through to throw into the dark.

name: Vicious Firecap
description: Hang by one arm from a ladder rung and toss a shell over the lip of a roof.

name: Draught Shrapnel
description: Test the rope with one hard pull before trusting body weight and a bandolier of shells to it.

name: Shielding Powderchamber
description: Raise the cloak to keep fine powder dust out of the eyes and off the fuse.

name: Discord Lever
description: Place a shell against the foot of a door so its burst breaks the bar and throws the leaves inward.

name: Ruthless Fragmentation
description: Throw a shell through a door and lie flat so its burst sweeps the room while the thrower stays safe in the passage.

name: Claycasing
description: Rush the opening in the thick of the smoke while the defenders are still blinded and deaf.

name: Grit Shockwave
description: Hop from one piece of cover to the next in the short gap between two bursts.

name: Recalllever
description: Look at the target for one breath from knee height and withdraw before any marksman can answer.

name: Shard Firecap
description: Keep the unlit side of a post toward the foe while the throw is readied behind it.

name: Candor Pinring
description: Count the foe's loading time and throw in that gap when no shot can be answered.

name: Bold Cap
description: Throw as the foot leaves one cover so the thrower is already moving when the shell lands.

name: Regimen Casing
description: Roll behind cover after a throw and throw again from the far end of the cover.
